findings.evidence: Changed docs/issues/91/design.md:85 now sets validator<=24s, consistent with security-contract.md:171-177's absolute24s request-header-to-reply/unwind deadline and stop-actionable-work-by23s rule. The affected normative admission-contract.md:149-153 still allocates a20s reader plus up to8s of a validator28s deadline for Kubernetes reads/CAS. An implementation following that sequence can still initiate durable work after the selected actionable deadline or lose its allow response after reserving the slot. This is a contract inconsistency, not a claim that durable CAS safety is broken.
findings.fix: Use the single absolute deadline throughout the admission sequence. Replace the28s/8s language with the remaining budget under24s, reserve the stated response/unwind time, and clamp reader/API/CAS subdeadlines accordingly. Include a slow-reader/API fixture proving no new actionable write starts after the cutoff while ambiguous submitted writes remain held.
